entry: This mod STARTS WHERE VANILLA ENDS: gobber2:gobber2_ore in the overworld requires a NETHERITE pickaxe to mine. There is no early game - the correct opening quest is 'obtain a netherite pickaxe', then 'mine Gobber Ore'.

Ore drops gobber2:gobber2_globette; NINE globettes CRAFT (not smelt) into gobber2:gobber2_glob; a glob + iron ingot + gold ingot + diamond crafts gobber2:gobber2_ingot. That ingot is the base of everything.

The gentler on-ramp is gobber2:gobber2_lucky_block - generates much shallower, needs only an IRON pickaxe, never trolls (guides stress: no explosions), and drops finished mod items like gooey foods and even fuel. A taste of the mod before the netherite wall.
Ore tooltips state Y-levels and vein sizes in-game - quests can trust the tooltip rather than restating numbers.
boss_order: No bosses of its own - but VANILLA bosses are its currency: the Wither must die repeatedly (nether stars for nether armor, end armor links, dragon star) and the Ender Dragon repeatedly (dragon head, dragon's breath, elytra) for the dragon tier.
order: 1. Netherite pickaxe -> overworld gobber2:gobber2_ore -> globettes -> gobber2:gobber2_glob -> gobber2:gobber2_ingot.

2. Gobber tier gear: tools/sword from ingots + gobber2:gobber2_rod (2 ingots); armor recipes include an emerald. Full set grants water breathing + passive healing + feeding. Chestplate ~11 armor, already past netherite.
3. gobber2:gobber2_pickaxe unlocks gobber2:gobber2_ore_nether. Nether ingot = 2 gobber ingots + nether glob + netherite scrap. Nether armor needs NETHER STARS; full set adds fire protection.

4. Nether gobber pickaxe unlocks gobber2:gobber2_ore_end. End ingot = 2 nether ingots + end glob + chorus flower. End armor is built from gobber2:gobber2_links_end (2 End Rings + 2 nether stars each) - ~40 armor total, 8000 durability, no fall damage, gliding.

5. Dragon tier caps it: smithing template + end armor piece + gobber2:dragon_star (nether star + 4 dragon's breath + 3 end gobber ingots + dragon head); the chestplate instead uses gobber2:dragon_elytra (real elytra + end ingots + dragon parts). Full dragon set = CREATIVE FLIGHT plus growing absorption - guides call the wearer 'pretty immortal'.

6. Alongside the gear ladder, QoL tools per tier: gobber2:gobber2_hammer (3x3, sneak for single-block), gobber2:gobber2_excavator (3x3 shovel), gobber2:gobber2_tree_axe (fells connected trees), gobber2:gobber2_paxel (pick+axe+shovel, 10 dmg), gobber2:gobber2_paxel_stars (paxel that shift-right-click places torches).

7. The trinket layer is the mod's real fame: rings (base gobber2:gobber2_ring = 4 ingots; nether/end ring tiers above) and medallions (gobber2:gobber2_medallion = 5 ingots) that work passively FROM THE INVENTORY - attraction magnet, return-to-bed, miner, farmer, husbandry, swiftness, curing, vision, phoenix, void (free travel to/from the End), blink, teleport, airwalking, stealth, explorer; medallions for stepping, water breathing, healing x3, experience, glowing, dolphin's grace, conduit power, village hero.

8. Staff layer: gobber2:gobber2_staff_clearing (12x6x12 vegetation wipe), _staff_nature (cycles sapling types, cane<->bamboo, makes gobber2:clear_glass), _staff_farmer / _staff_harvest (grow and auto-harvest), _staff_stars (infinite torches), _staff_sniper (~60 damage hitscan arrow - one right-click kills a Warden-adjacent health pool), _staff_ensnarement (captures passive mobs/villagers).
9. Combo weapons close the tree: gobber2:gobber2_sword_traveler (end sword + Ring of the Traveler; right-click infinite air-jumps) and gobber2:gobber2_sword_sniper (end sword + staff of the sniper).
Fuel thread through it all: gobber2:gobber2_foo tiers smelt 320/480/640 items - outlasts coal and lava for mass smelting.
gates: HARD GATE at entry: netherite pickaxe for overworld gobber ore. Then a strict tool ladder - gobber pickaxe gates nether gobber ore, nether gobber pickaxe gates end gobber ore. Skipping a tier is impossible.
Nether star gates: nether armor, end armor links AND the dragon star each consume them - plan multiple Wither fights.
Dragon tier is gated on Ender Dragon farming: dragon head, 4x dragon's breath per star, plus a real elytra for the chestplate.
End ingots need a chorus flower - an End-side plant, so the End must be visited before end-tier crafting starts (or use the Ring of the Void once available).
traps: The Traveler Sword's infinite right-click jump has no landing plan - guides demonstrate dying to their own ascent. Fall management (end armor's no-fall, dragon flight) belongs BEFORE this toy.
The tree axe only fells CONNECTED logs and deliberately under-cuts so it cannot delete builds - players read partial fells as a bug.
The hammer's 3x3 is always-on; sneaking is the documented way to mine a single block - precision mining without sneak eats floors.

Rings and medallions overlap heavily (healing, water breathing, speed); medallions are 5 ingots vs 4 plus extras for rings - guides note the ring works out slightly cheaper. A quest chain should not require both of a duplicate pair.
4-w35W3MRW4 shows a Staff of Transformation and a Sonic Boom staff - those ids do NOT exist in the 1.20.1-2.8.9 jar (newer version content); do not emit them.
Blink ring teleports only to loaded, visible blocks and can catch on invisible/unloaded geometry - flashy but unreliable as a quest task.
signature: The glob ladder: gobber2:gobber2_glob -> _glob_nether -> _glob_end, with gobber2:gobber2_globette as the drop unit.
gobber2:gobber2_lucky_block family - the friendly, never-hostile lucky block.
gobber2:gobber2_ring_attraction and gobber2:gobber2_ring_void - the two rings every guide dwells on (magnet; free End travel).
gobber2:dragon_star and gobber2:dragon_elytra - the dragon-tier tokens; full set = creative flight.
gobber2:gobber2_paxel_stars - paxel plus torch placement, the mod's QoL in one item.
gobber2:gobber2_glass family - light-emitting glass, plus gobber2:clear_glass via the Staff of Nature.
